findings.evidence: `Tangent/Adjoint.lean:8` imports `Tangent.Lie.Basic`, and lines 204–241 are the only Lie-specific declarations; `Tangent.lean:7` imports `Tangent.Adjoint` while its module documentation assigns Lie structure to `Tangent.Lie`.
findings.fix: Move the `LieAdjoint` section to `Tangent/Lie/Adjoint.lean`, remove the `Tangent.Lie.Basic` import from `Tangent/Adjoint.lean`, and import the new module from `Tangent/Lie.lean`.
findings.issue: `adDerivation_lie` belongs under `Tangent/Lie`, while its current placement forces `Tangent.Adjoint` to import and re-export `Tangent.Lie.Basic`; consequently `Tangent.lean` exposes Lie structure although line 16 says it lives in the `Tangent.Lie` aggregator.

summary: The Lie-specific adjoint theorem is placed in the non-Lie tangent module, causing the general tangent aggregator to expose Lie structure despite its documented boundary.
